card.name: Small words before 'object' or 'string'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the' or 'to' in programming or technical prose, right where the next word is likely 'object', 'string' or 'integer'. It also fires on a few adjectives like 'short' or 'sharp' before a noun.

modes.label: Linking word in programming text
modes.description: 'the', 'to' or 'whether' just before a noun like integer, number or object-oriented in computing descriptions.

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: A short descriptive word where a concrete noun such as piece or distance comes next.
modes.example: A dog that cut an artery on a<< sharp>> piece of metal.

card.writes: It suppresses programming type words like object, string and vector as the next word, so it steers the model away from predicting them.
card.plain: It fires on little words in technical text where the model should not guess 'object' or 'string' next.
